newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Stoyanov leads Bulgaria poll - commission official.
newsitem.headline: Stoyanov leads Bulgaria poll - commission official.

text.p: Partial results from Sunday's Bulgarian presidential elections showed opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov leading with 43.65 percent but short of a first round majority, an electoral commission official said on Monday.
Ivan Marazov, candidate of the governing Socialists, was running second with 27.07 percent.
George Ganchev, leader of the Bulgarian Business Bloc, was third with 22.18 percent, the official said.
The official declined to specify what percentage of votes had been counted so far. The commission has said it will announce preliminary figures at a news conference at 3 p.m. (1300 GMT).
If full results, due on Wednesday morning, show no candidate has an absolute majority, a second round will be held on Sunday.
